name: Great Tree

notes: Serves as the metaphorical source of the sons and daughters chosen by the Mother's Prayer.
Each chosen individual is described as fruit produced by the tree.
If one chosen individual does not fulfill the role, another bud may eventually grow.
Gerk is described as a son/child of the Great Tree.
The Great Tree apparently has multiple sons and daughters besides Gerk.
Those who join Gerk become metaphorical brothers and sisters to him and relatives of the Great Tree's other children.

openQuestions: What is the true nature of the Great Tree beyond the metaphor?
What exactly is the Great Tree?
What responsibilities or powers come from joining Gerk under the Great Tree?
